d.seg: क्या करते हो विडियो खोल लो विडियो खोल
d.tr: What do you do, open video, open video
d.ctx: The speaker asks the other person to open their video, and then mentions Instagram in the following turn.
d.j: Matches the strong case of asking to show the body or open video.

d.ctx: The speaker previously asked to open video and now asks whether to do it here or on Instagram, to which the other person replies positively.
d.j: Matches the strong case of proposing to move to a named external app.
